title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with the necessary nutrients to ensure the healthy development of their baby. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnant women, helping to build balanced and nutritious meals.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnant Women
The following international pantry staples are good options for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, helping to support digestive health and reduce the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, helping to support bone and tooth development.
- Lentils: rich in iron, helping to support the production of red blood cells.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, helping to support brain and vision development.
- Eggs: rich in protein, helping to support muscle development.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, helping to support immune function and reduce the risk of disease.

## Combining Foods to Build Balanced Meals
To build balanced meals, pregnant women can combine these international pantry staples with each other. For example:
- Breakfast: oats with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: lentils with leafy greens and citrus.
- Dinner: low-mercury salmon with eggs and leafy greens.

## Food Safety Considerations
Pregnant women need to consider food safety when preparing and consuming these foods. Some important considerations:
- Cook food before consuming.
- Avoid consuming raw or undercooked food.
- Wash hands and utensils before preparing food.

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with the necessary nutrients to ensure the healthy development of their baby. International pantry staples like oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus can help build balanced and nutritious meals. To learn more about pregnancy nutrition and recipes, expectant mothers can visit our [pregnancy meal planner](/planner) or [prenatal nutrition](/blog/topics) pages.

## When to Seek Help
If expectant mothers have any questions or concerns about pregnancy nutrition, they should seek help from their healthcare provider or a registered dietitian. They can provide personalized advice and guidance to help ensure the healthy development of their baby.
